ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no account flag on the driver (GPS alone is insufficient to establish button abuse under the 200 m data-layer radius).

rejected_claims.reason: NS-1(ii) not met: GPS shows the driver ~201 m from the pickup pin (outside the 200 m arrival radius) at the moment he pressed 'I'm Here' and throughout the wait, so the no-show cancellation fee does not stand; the driver's own 'side road' chat message corroborates this.
